title: Combination opening hours and admission qualifications
goal: uses logical operations to simultaneously check whether the exhibition hall is open and whether the visitor has an admission ticket.
summary: For Boolean conditions, && requires both sides to be true, and || requires at least one side to be true. Use parentheses to group alternative conditions.
tasks: Write the entry condition inside the curly braces of canEnterHall. The exhibition hall must be open, and visitors also need to have a ticket or a work permit. One of the two vouchers is sufficient.
isOpen, hasTicket, and hasStaffPass are all Boolean values. Use return to return the combined boolean result.
hint: takes "has a ticket or work permit" as a condition and then combines it with "exhibition hall is open". When the museum is closed, you can try it with a work permit.

example.note: People who have subscribed to reminders will receive a reminder when an event is about to start or when the location changes.
